name: label_propagation
author: a018559c
description: Finds communities by repeatedly assigning each node the most common label among its neighbors, using a seeded random order and tie-breaking. Directed edges are treated as undirected for community detection. It returns labeled community samples, registers each returned community as a subgraph, and exposes the largest community through result_graph_id.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of largest communities to return.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible node order and tie-breaking.
